summary.text: Kim Haggan is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 36 since December 3, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired teacher, she is running against Clifton Foster III (D).

paragraphs.text: Kim Haggan earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Farmington in 1982, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
She won the District 36 seat in the November 2024 general election, defeating independent candidate Shelby D. Wright, and she advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
